CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_opp_today_vn()
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trang_thai_mua(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aka_order o
                  WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(o.is_demo,false) = false
                    AND lower(COALESCE(o.package,'')) <> 'demo'
                    AND o.date_expiration >= now())
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.org_organization_product q
                   JOIN public.org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
                  WHERE g.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted,false) = false
                    AND q.is_paid
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_lock,false) = false
                    AND q.expiration_date >= now())
    THEN 'dang_dung'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aka_order o
                  WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(o.is_demo,false) = false
                    AND lower(COALESCE(o.package,'')) <> 'demo')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.org_organization_product q
                   JOIN public.org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
                  WHERE g.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted,false) = false
                    AND q.is_paid)
    THEN 'het_han'
    ELSE 'chua_mua'
  END;
$function$
